parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Specifies the page number from which to start displaying the results.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the number of records to display on each page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter **ResourceGroupId** is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The device status. Valid values:

- **0**: inactive.
- **1**: online.
- **3**: offline.
- **8**: disabled.
